onboarding-agent.description: Phase 0 onboarding: reverse-engineer contexts, architecture, ADRs from existing codebase

planning-agent.description: Discovery & Architecture: scope/architecture approval; after design: task decomposition, estimates, token budgets, final sign-off

design-agent.description: System Design (before sign-off): API contracts, data models, interfaces

alignment-agent.description: Gate: DDD compliance, architecture verification, code review

development-agent.description: Full delivery: Core domain, integrations, generic assembly, tests, CI/CD, deploy

guard-agent.description: Transition gate: reads Handoff Reports, blocks if Open Questions or Unconfirmed Decisions exist

clarification-agent.description: Recovery: presents blocked questions to operator, collects answers, records decisions
